providers.comment: One pixel-wide column of Wynncraft's rank pill background (its 6x7 chat/banner glyph, same ascent and height), so a gradient pill can be filled a column at a time and graded smoothly instead of once per letter. White on purpose: Minecraft multiplies a glyph by the text colour, so the mod tints each column at render time.
A bitmap glyph always advances one pixel past its width. Following a column with this pulls the next one back against it, so columns sit edge to edge.
